Definition: properly, a pebble, i.e. a lot (small stones being used for that purpose); figuratively, a portion or destiny (as if determined by lot)
BiblicalUsage: 1) lot; 1a) lot-pebbles used for systematically making decisions; 2) portion; 2a) lot, portion (thing assigned by casting lots); 2b) recompense, retribution
